newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Arafat to travel to Washington on Tuesday, diplomats.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to travel to Washington on Tuesday, diplomats.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will travel to Washington on Tuesday after a meeting with EU foreign ministers on Monday, Irish diplomats said.
"They've (the Palestinian delegation) told us he's going to Washington," a diplomat said.
The diplomats were unable to say whether Arafat would participate in a summit called by U.S. President Bill Clinton.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will be at the Washington summit but Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak has said he will not attend.
Asked at the airport when he arrived what he wanted from Netanyahu, Arafat told reporters:
"I am not asking for the moon, I am only asking for what had been agreed upon and what had been signed to be implemented accurately and honestly."

"The agreement which I had signed (was) not with the Labour Party, I signed it with the government of Israel. This had been accepted in the Knesset (the Israeli parliament), also it had been accepted in our legislative council and in our national council."
"So we are committed to it, the Israelis are committed to it, and we have to do our best to protect the peace process."
